name: Jeunesse Bel Agir (Kahoot)
author: akramboussanni@users.noreply.github.com
description: Jeunesse Bel Agir live quiz game (belagirkahoot) with optional token-authenticated Cloudflare Tunnel. PostgreSQL and Redis run inside the container, with data in /home/container, unless their URLs are set. With a tunnel, set its public hostname service to http://localhost:8080; no allocation is needed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/redis
echo "Application is bundled in the yolk; no download required."

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Address players open, with no trailing slash, e.g. https://kahoot.example.org. Must match exactly: it is the only origin allowed to open game WebSockets, and email links use it.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Leave empty to run PostgreSQL inside the container, with its data in postgres/. To use an external server instead: postgres://USER:URL_ENCODED_PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DB?sslmode=disable.

variables.name: JWT secret
variables.description: Signs host sessions. Leave empty to generate one on first start, kept in .jwt-secret. Changing it signs everyone out.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel token
variables.description: Token from a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel. Set its public hostname service to http://localhost:8080. Empty disables the tunnel and serves the app on the allocation port instead, which then requires an allocation.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: External redis:// or rediss:// URL. Empty runs a private Redis inside the container, which is enough for one server.

variables.name: SMTP host
variables.description: Mail server for verification and password reset emails. Hosts cannot log in until they verify their email.

variables.name: SMTP password
variables.description: Password or app password for the mail server.

variables.name: Gemini API key
variables.description: Optional. Enables AI quiz generation, or serves as fallback.

variables.name: AI generations per hour
variables.description: Per-host limit on AI quiz generations.
